description: fixtures2/00117: a macro's `t = 99` overwrites the caller's `t` on every path. Quote builds every var node with a Nil context (jobs/body.rs:1330-1336), decode drops the slot (quoted_function.rs:306-307), and lowering binds by name only (body.rs:1170, 1940, 3341). Elixir stamps a context and a per-expansion counter (elixir_quote.erl:94-122, 265-343), with var! to escape (special_forms.ex:967-1024; pages/meta-programming/macros.md:109-131). Fix: VarContext on Expr::Var/Pattern::Var; quote stamps it, decode keeps it, the lowering env is keyed by (name, context); add var!; macro-expansion.md gets a hygiene section. 00119 then passes by construction, not by accident. Needs its own detailed proposal page before building. Proposal: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-p8p.4-findings.html (approved 2026-09-26). One commit. The fixture moves to fixtures/ and its port test is deleted in the same commit.
title: Macro hygiene: quoted variables carry a context
